text:
hana: I opened a concise playbook PR consolidating v1->v2 steps and snippet owners: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987 — need quick eyes on streaming + embed notes.

mike: I can take the streaming examples. Will add legacy vs v2 patterns and a tiny helper `collectStream()` for partial-json assembly.

sara: I'll own embed guidance and the reindex checklist. Planning a short pseudo CLI for batch reindex and a cost note per 100k rows.

hana: Nice. Marketing asked for a one-line banner. Draft: "Redwood will retire the v1 API Sep 1, 2026. Migrate to v2 by Aug 1 to avoid interruption." Thoughts?

liz: Good. Add link to guide in parentheses. Also please soften slightly for customers in EU/APAC.

mike: Streaming note: v1 examples used newline-json. v2 SDKs return async iterators; show both and recommend `for await` pattern.

sara: Reindex pseudo: `reindex --src old-emb --dst new-emb --batch 500`. Add a WARN about vector-store compatibility.

hana: CI: add `docs-smoke` GH Action to run top TS+py snippets against a local v2 shim. Who can add the job?

mike: I'll add the GH Action and a small docker-compose shim. It will post status to the PR.

docs-bot: Please tag files with `owner:` labels and add a changelog entry under `docs/changes/2026-04-06.md`.

liz: Action owners: mike (streaming + CI), sara (embeds + reindex), hana (merge + narrative). Aim to merge by 2026-04-14 if smoke tests pass.

hana: Thanks — I'll also add an appendix about model-aliases and recommend pinning exact versions for prod.

mike: Pushed iterator examples and helper util. Will follow up with small PR for the CI job.

sara: Adding reindex cost estimate and checklist.

liz: If no major comments and CI green, merge after 48h review. :thumbsup:
